page.overview:
What is Cutie Wagon?

The Cutie Wagon is a vessel used by Porche, Capote and pulled by Monda during the Donut Race portion of the Davy Back Fight.

The vessel is shaped like half of a giant pink seashell. The ship could be said to resemble a seashell or a pink sleigh with a tapered front.

With Monda pulling, it was a fast craft. Despite this, the Cutie Wagon only won the race due to the interference of the cheating from Foxy. Monda stood in front, and Porche was the attacking force, while Capote rowed the oars (both located vertically in the "Seashell" over-flap).
